# Hospitals

This folder catalogs individual hospitals and specialized hospital departments across Denmark that participate in the national DANIBD quality monitoring program for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). The pages detail each facility's clinical performance against national quality indicators—such as diagnostic colonoscopies, DEXA scanning, and fecal calprotectin testing—alongside internal audits, operational feedback, and specific digital health initiatives like the Constant-Care app. Together, these records illustrate the varied compliance rates, systemic challenges, and localized quality improvement efforts characterizing Danish IBD care.

## Pages

- [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] — A major university hospital that audited Indicator 1 compliance and raised concerns about data capture validity while failing the Indicator 1a target for adult diagnostics.
- [[herlev-mave-tarm-leversygd|"Herlev Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygd."]] — The gastroenterology and hepatology department at Herlev, tracking compliance rates for DEXA scans and fecal calprotectin measurements.
- [[hvidovre-gastroenheden|Hvidovre Gastroenheden]] — A gastroenterology unit demonstrating a sharp disparity in clinical compliance, scoring low on DEXA scans but exceptionally high on calprotectin testing.
- [[hvidovre|Hvidovre]] — A major university department handling specialized pediatric VEO-IBD diagnostics that also fell below the 70% threshold for adult diagnostic Indicator 1a.
- [[nordsjaelland-kirurgisk-overafdeling|Nordsjælland Kirurgisk overafdeling]] — A surgical department tracking its fulfillment of national indicators, noting historical lows in DEXA scanning compliance.
- [[nordsjaellands-hospital|Nordsjællands Hospital]] — A Capital Region facility notable for its local NPU coding for point-of-care calprotectin and high adoption of the Constant-Care digital monitoring app.
- [[ouh-odense-kirurgisk-afdeling-a|OUH Odense Kirurgisk Afdeling A]] — A surgical department that conducted an internal audit to improve steroid tapering and acute patient management dialogue.
- [[ouh-odense-medicinsk-mave-tarm-afd-s|OUH Odense Medicinsk Mave-Tarm Afd. S]] — A medical department recognized as a regional benchmark for postoperative care, being the only large facility to meet the Indicator 3 colonoscopy target.
- [[ouh-svendborg|OUH Svendborg]] — A healthcare facility identified as falling short of the Indicator 1a guidelines for examining newly diagnosed adult IBD patients.
- [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] — A regional hospital that audited re-operation rates and argued that anastomotic leakage is a more accurate surgical quality metric.
- [[rigshospitalet-med-klinik-mave-tarm-lever|"Rigshospitalet Med. Klinik Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygd."]] — One of the country's largest gastroenterology departments, contributing extensive data despite recording the lowest national fulfillment for DEXA scanning in 2023.
- [[slb-vejle-medicinsk-afdeling|SLB Vejle Medicinsk Afdeling]] — A medical department evaluated across multiple indicators, historically ranking among the lowest for systematic calprotectin follow-up before improving in later reports.
